body:
Maintainer's decision (2026-09-19): the app is called "Tuppu" (Akkadian: a clay tablet) — "Shopping List" now names one of three list kinds and no longer fits as the product name.

Scope: the user-facing name only. app.title (web, 9 locales) and app_name (Android, 9 locales) become the proper noun "Tuppu", untranslated; web/index.html <title>; the invite landing page title; README.md, android/README.md, web/README.md headings and a line saying what the name means; server/pyproject.toml description. Tests that assert the old name (web i18n.test.ts document.title and translate("de","app.title"), LoginPage.test.tsx heading, any Android test) follow.

Out of scope, deliberately: every technical identifier stays — applicationId org.p23q.shoppinglist (changing it strands every installed app), the shoppinglist_server package and wheel, the /shoppinglist.apk route the update checker polls, the repo name, and the "Shopping list" LIST KIND label, which is a kind, not the product.
title: Rebrand the product name to Tuppu on both clients, the invite page and the docs
